question: If TM and TN are the two tangents to a circle with centre O so that ∠MON = 105°, then ∠MTN will be equal to:
solution:
**Concpet:**

Tangents drawn from an external point are perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e8125a28652e51d7f4b862c0d729ada60fd13fda0093b56a04ac06e01a72929.png] 

Given, TM and TN are tangents.

 ∠MON = 105°

Now, angle in a quadrilateral = 360°

⇒ ∠ MON + ∠ ONT + ∠ MTN + ∠ TMO = 360° 

⇒ 105° + 90° + 90° + ∠ MTN = 360° 

⇒ **∠ MTN = 75° .**
